text:
alex: Heads up — during a canary run at ~11:43 UTC I saw P95 jump from ~120ms to ~850ms on long-context model requests. Correlated with heavy KV pager churn and a flood of eviction activity. Repro locally with a synthetic long-context workload; looks like eviction policy flip to FIFO + batching causes a pathological reinsertion loop.

maria: logs?

alex: pasted a tiny excerpt from the node logs:
```
[11:43:12.341] evicter: eviction round start slots=1024 pressure=0.87 policy=FIFO
[11:43:12.342] evicter: evict_batch count=64 -> page_faults=47 reinserts=18
[11:43:12.343] pager: writeback waiting on page_mutex (owner=thread-87)
[11:43:12.347] latency: request_id=abc123 p95=842ms
```

sam: That pattern smells like reinsert chains + page locks. When FIFO reinserts are enabled we avoid alloc/copy but we can reinsert the same keys repeatedly if hotset migrates across pages. Under batching those reinserts interleave with new requests and we get lock contention and lots of small writes.

nora: We flipped `deferred_reinsert` for FIFO in the q3 patch to reduce copy overhead — may be exposing this under high batch throughput.

ben: I can repro with a small harness. Steps I used: `tools/kv_repro --pattern alternating-hotset --qps 450 --max_tokens_per_batch=1024 --ctx_len=32768` — triggers in ~2 minutes.

alex: I ran a CPU + perf sampling while reproing. Hot stacks point to: `evicter::evict_batch -> page_mutex::lock -> reinsert_sweep -> writeback` and repeated syscalls for `madvise`/`msync`. Flamegraph saved to /artifacts/2535009876/kv_eviction_profile.svg (baseline vs bad run). Summary: reinserts increase with batch size and page watermarks.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary rack-12/k8s v3.4.2 rolled at 11:30 (metadata: canary=true)

sam: Quick mitigations that helped in my sandbox: set `evicter.max_reinserts=2` and reduce `batcher.max_batch_tokens` from auto to 512. On my repro that dropped P95 from ~800ms to ~180ms. Also toggling FIFO->LRU removed the reinserts but raised some steady-state copy cost.

nora: Proposal: add a safety guard — when paging_ratio > 0.8 or reinserts_per_round > 8, disable FIFO reinserts and fallback to LRU-safe path for the remainder of the eviction round. Also emit telemetry counter `kv.evict.reinserts_guard_tripped`.

alex: +1. Also add a throttle that limits reinserts per-evicter-thread per-round to avoid the hot-loop. We'll need unit + integration perf test.

ben: I'll open a PR with the guard + a microbenchmark. PR will include: a) guard toggle, b) repro harness for CI, c) a perf test that asserts P95 < 300ms on the long-context scenario. Drafting now — PR #4523.

maria: Also we should add a correctness test around LRU<->FIFO transition to ensure we never drop entries incorrectly when we flip policies under load. A synthetic test that alternates policy while hammering the same keyset should catch regressions.

alex: Good call. For rollout plan: land the guard behind a feature flag, run a 1h canary on canary rack, then promote. If telemetry shows no trips but perf still bad, we revert deferred_reinsert change.

sam: I'll run the canary tonight and attach perf captures. Going to try the smaller batch config first to validate mitigations.

nora: I'll add the `kv.evict.reinserts_guard_tripped` metric to the Ops dashboard and wire an alert for >5 per minute during canary.

alex: Thanks folks. Artifacts: /artifacts/2535009876/kv_eviction_profile.svg, /artifacts/2535009876/kv_repro_trace.json. Leaving canary run to @sam; ping me if it flaps. :thumbsup:
